'''Jatta Kuum''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] who worked as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Jatta Kuum was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] who worked as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed in the [[Nikto Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where he was monitoring separatist movements funded by [[Kata]] the Hutt. Kata's profits from his illegal pit fights went to the separatists on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and other [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="SWTORBM" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
A traveling hero helped him stop Kata's pit fights - and thereby the funding of the separatists - by destroying Kata's vault, where all of the Hutt's files were held. After the vault was destroyed, Kuum told the hero that he planned to infiltrate the movements.<ref name="SWTORBM" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jatta Kuum appears in the mission "Blood Money" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
